tools.name: discover_offerings
tools.description: Browse every published offering in the Agent Company Index (B2B software and services, sourced facts, explicit limitations), in stable alphabetical order. Prefer search_offerings when the user describes a need; use this to page through the whole index.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Get the full sourced record of one offering by slug: who it is for and not for, limitations, prerequisites, data residency, pricing visibility, contract terms, open questions, the company's relationship to ACI's operator, and a source with checked date for every claim. Use before recommending or com

tools.name: search_offerings
tools.description: Use when a user is looking for a B2B software product, service provider or agency (e.g. "website maintenance for a small company in Germany", "time tracking with DATEV export") and wants options backed by sourced facts and stated limitations rather than marketing. Plain-language search over the Agen

tools.name: evaluate_situation
tools.description: Check a structured buyer situation (category, company size, country, requirements) against every published offering and get eligible, partial and excluded results with reasons. Use when the situation maps to the schema categories; for plain-language needs use search_offerings.

tools.name: request_listing
tools.description: Ask ACI to list one offering of the company you act for. Returns a reference, a private listing token (shown once) and the domain-control challenge. ACI is a curated index: a request is reviewed and does not guarantee a listing. Nothing is published until the company approves an exact draft and ACI

tools.name: update_listing_answers
tools.description: Send or correct the company's structured answers. Once a draft exists this requests changes: ACI prepares a new revision from the answers, and any earlier approval no longer counts. A free-text note is read by a person at ACI and is not published.

tools.name: verify_listing_domain
tools.description: Check the domain-control challenge from request_listing (DNS TXT record or file at /.well-known/aci-verification.txt on the company domain).

tools.name: get_listing_status
tools.description: Read the state of a listing request and, once prepared, the full draft with its revision digest and every fact and source.

tools.name: approve_listing
tools.description: Approve publication of the exact draft revision on behalf of the company. Requires a verified domain. Only call after the company has reviewed the draft.

detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing_status · Private data: get_offering, search_offerings, request_listing, verify_listing_domain, approve_listing, request_listing_removal · Public sink: update_listing_answers, approve_listing, request_listing_removal · Destructive: request_listing_removal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing_status · Private data: get_offering, search_offerings, request_listing, verify_listing_domain, approve_listing, request_listing_removal · Public sink: update_listing_answers, approve_listing, request_listing_removal · Destructive: request_listing_removal

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
